core: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon response
qualifier: RIG-I/MDA5 regulation and antiviral effectors (OAS, IP-10)
name: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing, type I interferon and antiviral effectors
rationale: All members concern RIG-I/MDA5 or cytosolic DNA sensing leading to IRF3-driven type I interferon and antiviral output; unlike the confusables the theme adds RIG-I/MDA5 regulators and downstream effectors (OAS, IP-10, IFN-alpha response) rather than TRAF/IRF7 or virus-evasion pathways.

name: Keratinocyte proliferation-differentiation balance in epidermal wound repair
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis and epithelial spreading during wound healing; confusables instead cover hair follicle, melanocyte, cornification and barrier formation.

name: Axon regeneration, collateral sprouting and Sema3A repulsion
rationale: Members control growth, sprouting and regeneration of axons and neurites, with Sema3A-plexin repulsion distinguishing the theme from glial/myelination and axon-extension confusables.

core: Peptide hormone GPCR signalling via cAMP
name: Calcitonin/amylin/CGRP and related peptide receptor cAMP signalling
rationale: Members are peptide-hormone GPCRs (calcitonin-like, relaxin, glucagon-type, somatostatin) acting through adenylate cyclase/cAMP; calcitonin-family and relaxin receptors set it apart from nutrient-receptor, feeding and insulin-secretion confusables.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signalling with senescence and growth-rate control
rationale: Members centre on Hippo/YAP-TAZ and cell-density control; replicative senescence, lifespan, X-ray response and growth rate are what this theme has that all confusables lack.

name: Intra-Golgi retrograde vesicle traffic
rationale: All three members concern vesicle recycling within the Golgi stack, unlike confusables on TGN/endosome-Golgi traffic, lysosomal sorting or Golgi structure.

name: RUNX1 transcriptional targets and megakaryocyte-erythroid differentiation
rationale: Members are RUNX1-regulated transcription across contexts plus megakaryocyte, platelet and erythroid differentiation; confusables cover granulocytic/myeloid progenitor and HSC programmes without the broad RUNX1 target set.

qualifier: vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered fusion
name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release
rationale: All members describe the exocytic release step (docking, SNARE assembly, priming, Ca2+-dependent fusion) for several transmitters, whereas confusables focus on vesicle recycling, clustering and presynaptic structure.

qualifier: canonical and non-canonical, with its regulation
name: IKK-mediated canonical and non-canonical NF-kB signalling regulation
rationale: Members converge on IKK/NIK-driven NF-kB activation from TNFR, TLR and antigen receptors, its linear ubiquitination and inherited IKK defects; confusables instead emphasise NOD/inflammasome and TAK1-JNK/p38 branches.

name: Chemokine receptor-driven dendritic cell and T/NK cell chemotaxis
rationale: Members are chemokine/receptor signalling (CCR7, CXCR4) directing migration of dendritic cells, T and NK cells; confusables cover B cell homing, integrin adhesion or monocyte chemokine clusters.

qualifier: FLT3, ALK, FGFR and PDGFR; inhibitor resistance
name: Oncogenic FLT3, ALK, FGFR and PDGFR mutants and kinase-inhibitor resistance
rationale: All members are cancer-associated RTK mutants, fusions or TKI-resistant variants of FLT3, ALK/LTK, FGFR and PDGFR, distinguishing it from KIT-focused and normal FLT3/cytokine signalling confusables.

name: Cardiac conduction system development and sinoatrial pacemaking
rationale: Members concern SA node, AV node and His-Purkinje development, HCN pacemaker channels and gap-junction coupling, whereas confusables cover action-potential phases and ion-channel electrophysiology.

name: Catecholamine reuptake by dopamine and norepinephrine transporters
rationale: All members concern plasma-membrane uptake of dopamine/norepinephrine and its transporter disorders, unlike confusables on catecholamine degradation, biosynthesis or vesicular loading.

name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation and matriglycan synthesis in dystroglycanopathy
rationale: Every member is O-mannosyl glycosylation of DAG1 or its congenital muscular dystrophy defects, distinct from keratan/GAG synthesis, mannose donor synthesis and muscle DGC confusables.

qualifier: constitutive secretion and Golgi membrane localization
name: Endocytic recycling and constitutive plasma membrane delivery
rationale: Members regulate endosome-plasma membrane recycling, endosome organization and constitutive secretory delivery; confusables are Rab/ARF signalling, early-to-late endosome or endosome-to-Golgi traffic.

name: Poly(ADP-ribose) turnover at DNA double-strand breaks
rationale: Members combine ADP-ribosylation/de-ADP-ribosylation with protein recruitment and chromatin remodeling at double-strand breaks, distinct from core NHEJ/HR, fork reversal and topology confusables.

name: RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signalling, its oncogenic mutants and negative feedback
rationale: Members cover RAS activation by SOS/GAPs, RAF-MEK-ERK, disease mutants and ERK inactivation; confusables focus on ERK5, AP-1, IL-6 or Rap1-integrin signalling.

name: Adenylate cyclase activation, cAMP turnover and PKA-CREB signalling
rationale: Members concern cAMP synthesis, degradation and PKA/CREB/DARPP-32 output downstream of Gs-coupled receptors, unlike the Gi-inhibitory adrenergic and PLC/IP3 confusables.

name: Centrosome positioning, centriole cohesion and MTOC microtubule nucleation
rationale: Members concern centrosome location, centriole cohesion and microtubule nucleation/anchoring at the MTOC, distinct from mitotic centrosome maturation, ciliogenesis and spindle orientation confusables.

qualifier: with urate transport and inherited transporter defects
name: Epithelial amino acid and urate transport and its inherited defects
rationale: Members are SLC amino acid and urate transporters of epithelial plasma membrane and their disorders (cystinuria, Hartnup, iminoglycinuria, hypouricemia), distinct from organic anion/cation and peptide transporter confusables.

name: Toll-like receptor signalling regulation and IL-6/IL-8/TNF production
rationale: Members positively/negatively regulate TLR (and CD40) signalling and the resulting inflammatory cytokine production, unlike confusables on TRIF/TAK1 mechanics or IL-1 signalling.

name: Eph-ephrin growth cone repulsion and Rac1-mediated guidance
rationale: Members are ephrin/Eph repulsion, growth cone collapse and Rac1/DCC guidance cues, distinguished from netrin-repulsion and ROBO-SLIT confusables by the Eph-ephrin pathways.

name: Colony-stimulating factor-driven neutrophil differentiation and granulopoiesis control
rationale: Members cover G-CSF/GM-CSF signalling and transcriptional control of neutrophil versus monocyte fate, distinct from progenitor, macrophage/DC and eosinophil/mast cell confusables.

name: Pharyngeal endoderm-derived thymus, thyroid and parathyroid development
rationale: All three members are development of pharyngeal-endoderm glands, unlike craniofacial, otic, cardiac outflow and gut mesoderm confusables.

core: TGF-beta receptor and SMAD cancer mutants
name: TGF-beta receptor/SMAD cancer mutants and betaglycan co-receptor regulation
rationale: Members are cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 plus TGFBR3 co-receptor control, distinct from wild-type TGF-beta, RUNX3/Hippo and activin confusables.
